name: UAC
source: CRON 2026-10-07: group consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 2025, printed page 26 of _ngx_pdf/UACN.pdf (PDF page 28), and the group five-year financial summary, printed page 96 (PDF page 98). The group statement shows a Minimum tax line of (810,641) separate from the income tax expense of (5,705,903), so the Income Tax row for FY2025 is the total 6,516,544, which is also the 6,517 the five-year summary prints for 2025 and is what makes profit before taxation less income tax equal the profit for the year. FY2023 to FY2022 come from the FY2023 audited annual report (uacnplc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/UACN-ANNUAL-REPORT-2023.pdf) because the FY2025 summary repeats the FY2024 taxation figure in its FY2023 column, which cannot be reconciled to that summary own profit after tax of 8,908. FY2021 is from the group five-year summary, with profit before taxation derived from the printed profit after tax and taxation. EPS is the group basic earnings per share in naira (printed kobo / 100): 362 and 497 kobo. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.derivedFrom: minimum tax plus income tax expense of continuing operations

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.derivedFrom: Net Profit - Income Tax for FY2021

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source

source_note: Profit before tax is the audited statement line "Profit/(loss) before minimum tax": NGN 16,425,008 thousand for FY2025 and NGN 25,547,275 thousand for FY2024 (NGX filing 46413). The terminal has no row for the separate minimum tax line, so profit before tax less the stored income tax row exceeds profit for the year by the minimum tax (810,641 in FY2025, 400,427 in FY2024). Figures NGN thousands. | H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47625_UAC__OF_NIGERIA_PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2021: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
